minutes.headline: Town manager warned of a 10% health insurance rise and a delayed tax rate; committee set board liaisons.
minutes.summary: The meeting was mostly a long town manager report covering the trash contract, local projects, the delayed revaluation and tax billing, health insurance estimates, and the special town meeting warrant. The committee then planned questions for the interim finance director and treasurer about trust accounts, and assigned liaisons to town boards. It chose not to reopen its primary school air conditioning vote and adjourned.

budget_items.topic: Green Communities grant and LED street light rewiring
budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager said the Green Communities grant has enough money for all associated costs. Who pays for the rewiring is still to be determined with Unitil.
EPA approved additional funding for further environmental work at the site.
The insurance representative estimated an increase for active plans and advised budgeting increases for the next five years.
The police chief submitted an article to transfer money from the opioid settlement stabilization fund for a mental health co-response program.

budget_items.topic: Ambulance and two DPW trucks funding source
budget_items.what_was_said: The select board may move funding for the three vehicles from ARPA to the special purpose stabilization fund, which needs town meeting approval.
About this much ARPA remains without changing the vehicle commitments.
Members discussed that the levy limit is 2.5% over the prior levy and that the delayed classification could affect the difference.

budget_items.what_was_said: The committee drafted questions about number of accounts, balances, appropriated funds and consolidation into higher-yield accounts.
A member said the committee got funds to hire a firm to scope and estimate projects. A school committee member suggested including Turkey Hill.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee held no votes; most of the meeting was a town manager report on the trash contract, projects, tax billing and health insurance.
The town manager's report covered a delayed revaluation and tax billing, and the insurance representative advised budgeting increases for the next five years.
The committee chose not to reopen its primary school air conditioning vote and will wait for the special town meeting article.
Board liaison assignments were made, with several boards lumped together and some left without a liaison.
The chair will send questions on trust and other accounts to the interim finance director and treasurer for a November meeting.

why_it_matters: Health insurance is a large, growing part of the town budget, and a multi-year increase plus a delayed tax rate can change the room under the levy limit and the timing of a tax bill.
The air conditioning project and the shift of vehicle funding from ARPA to a stabilization fund are likely to reach residents as special town meeting articles they will be asked to vote on.
watch_next: Meetings noted for September 28, October 12 and October 26, with the trust account questions slated for a November meeting.
The special town meeting warrant, including the primary school air conditioning article and the possible ARPA-to-stabilization-fund transfer for three vehicles.
